title: material.reaction_triggered
description: M15 § Active Material Kernel — per-pixel reaction trigger. Fires when two adjacent pixels match a MaterialReaction entry from the M15D registry (acid+iron, water+lava, oil+fire, etc.). Producer: cf-material::reactions evaluator dispatched by the CA stepper. M15B extension: `emissions` array carries tertiary gas products spawned into adjacent air cells (e.g. wood+fire emits smoke+CO2 alongside the charcoal residue + fire cascade). Additive-only per M4 DR-002.

emissions.description: M15B § Tertiary materials spawned into adjacent air cells (e.g. wood-fire → [smoke, CO2]). Empty for reactions with no tertiary outputs.

emission_positions.description: M15B § World-space positions of the spawned emission pixels. Same length as `emissions`. Entries [i32::MIN, i32::MIN] indicate the emission was dropped (no adjacent air cell available).
